author: blu
body: Proves the AI mulligan wired into the pre-game. A hand with a workable mana count (two to five sources) is kept as-is; a no-land hand is mulliganed -- reshuffled and redrawn, London-style, then one card bottomed per mulligan taken. Cards are conserved (the deck stays 60 between library and hand), so a mulligan never loses or duplicates a card. Card 0 is a Forest (a mana source); card 1 is a Lightning Bolt (a spell).
